snippet.title: STICKER/BALL - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play STICKER/BALL on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537690/_STICKERBALL/  

In STICKER/BALL you fire balls. Hit dice with the balls to earn points, and ricochet back for even more. 

You’ll also unlock stickers. These come in many forms: spiders, poop, clown. Stickers can interact in strange ways. For example, poop attracts flies. Spiders make webs. Spider webs catch flies. More points for you!

Battle a gauntlet of weird opponents, unlock cool new stickers, and stack crazy combos for lots and lots of points. Once you run out of balls it’s game over :( But you can take what you learned and try again! :)

FEATURES
- 100+ Unique Stickers
- 36 Dastardly Enemies
- Roguelike mechanics
- Cool music
- Fun
- Frogs can hijack spaceships

Thank you for checking out my game! I hope you like it!!
Bilge
